## ✨ Highlights

- **New agent: Pi** — HarnessKit now manages [Pi](https://pi.dev) as its 17th agent: skills (including the shared `~/.agents/skills` tree Pi reads), MCP servers with install and enable/disable, and `.ts` extensions with enable/disable, plus its rules (`AGENTS.md`) and settings files.
- **Bug fixes** — narrow windows no longer cut off the onboarding agent row, the Extensions filter bar or the page headers; an agent that is no longer installed no longer keeps its extensions in the Overview counts.
